title: Five-door wardrobe, built in
summary: IKEA PAX frames and panelled doors, filled to the ceiling and walls so it looks made to measure.
intro: A white five-door wardrobe for a bedroom in Finchley. It started as IKEA PAX frames and panelled doors. Fillers to the ceiling and the side wall, plus gold handles, turn it into a built-in.

model3d.title: The SketchUp model in 3D
model3d.text: The wardrobe drawn in SketchUp from the photos, at standard IKEA PAX sizes rather than measured ones. Open the doors to see the rails, shelves and drawers, or take it apart to see the three frames and the fillers that make it a built-in.
